note: Kernel M1/M2 task claims. Every verified/implemented entry carries sourceHashes; scripts/update-roadmap.mjs blocks source drift. Accepted is human-only. M2b libc is approved by docs/adr-kernel-native-fs-syscalls.md. October 15 app/surface implementation hashes are refreshed only after retained offline command/frontend checks; live/keyring conformance remains unproven. M3 foundation claims live separately in evidence/m3/status.json.

m1.registry.note: Project identity, .projectos sidecar, register/open/move, alias rejection and the writer lock; 8 contract tests + M1 acceptance A1/A3/A4.

m1.graphs.note: GraphEngine trait + in-memory adapter (byte-stable snapshots, cycle-safe lineage) and the profile split with sidecar-UUID authority; M1 acceptance A2.

m1.capabilities.note: Capability broker (component-relative resolution, realpath containment, symlink-write refusal) + WorkerHost trait; 6 contract + 18 adversarial tests.

m1.mutation.note: Append-only journal, quiesced checkpoints, replay and recorded stale-lock takeover; M1 acceptance A1/A4/A5.

m1.trace.note: Durable redacted receipt facts + broker-denial ingestion verified by tests. The trace VIEWER is mock-bridged (native wiring is M2.1), so this stays 'implemented', not 'verified'.

m1.offline.note: Central offline enforcement is not built (an M1 non-goal). Recorded, not claimed.

m2.editor.note: Byte-range selection anchors; a stale selection fails safely (M2 acceptance A2).

m2.actions.note: Typed selection actions with declared contracts (Rephrase/Complete=Replacement, Explain/FactCheck=Annotation); stale anchors refused.

m2.diff.note: Proposal/diff/decision/revision loop: atomic apply, recoverable content-addressed before-image, journal + redacted receipt; reject mutates nothing (A2/A3). M2b routed apply/RevisionLog through DocumentStore; a Replacement's revision after_hash is stable_hash(whole new document).

m2.recipe.note: Inspectable, bounded, cancellable publish-readiness recipe with a human approval gate.

m2.context.note: One-hop / lineage / evidence lens rows (deterministic, table-equivalent).

m2.milestone.note: Named milestones (quiesced checkpoints) + portable export (no secrets/.tmp).

m2.e2e.note: Offline end-to-end Substack golden path with a redacted, model-disclosing receipt (no live provider).

m2.store.note: Native DocumentStore (M2.1): pinned root, openat(O_NOFOLLOW) per descent, atomic replace with a stale-write guard and a retained content-addressed before-image, bounded discovery, refusal of lexical escapes / symlinks / .projectos / objects. libc is confined here (ADR accepted 2026-10-11). 6 module tests + a reviewer 18-test adversarial suite; verified offline on macOS.

m2.review.note: Independent reviewer adversarial suite (18 tests) + review note. Found one contained scope bug (metadata objects/ leak) - fixed; judged the m2_acceptance assertion edit a correction, not a weakening; the libc deviation is carried to an accepted ADR.

m2.transport.note: M2.2 fixed-endpoint OpenRouter BYOK transport: endpoints pinned behind a Target enum (loopback is #[cfg(test)] only), price/model frozen at prepare, bounded wire/event/output sizes, secret redacted across SSE/UTF-8 splits, retries and fallbacks disabled. Synthetic local-HTTP tests only; live conformance is owner opt in and unproven.

m2.credentials.note: M2.2 OS-keyring credential boundary: macOS/Apple and Linux secret-service native backends enforced, no plaintext or in-memory fallback, zeroized values, no secret returned to the renderer. The isolated keyring conformance test is owner opt in (PROJECTOS_TEST_KEYRING=1) and unproven in this environment.

m2.app.note: Native command layer and single writer session implementing docs/EDITOR-PROVIDER-IPC.md. October 15 offline regression: evidence/m3/report.json and native.txt, 42 native tests pass, 2 explicit live/keyring tests ignored. Type/refusal/partial-effect checks added; implementation-only status retained. Historical M2b audit remains historical; no live/keyring claim.

m2.surface.note: Native-only bridge and editor surface; October 15 offline regression retained in evidence/m3/report.json and node.txt, including byte-range, CRLF and UTF-16/UTF-8 tests. Modal error accessibility refined; implementation-only status retained, not full UI acceptance.

m2.live.note: Live OpenRouter conformance against a real account (priced/billed cost reporting) requires owner opt-in resources; deferred, not claimed.
